name: Python URL Slug Helper
prompt: slug.py defines slugify(text, max_len=60). Implement it: lower-case; turn accented Latin letters into plain ASCII (e.g. é -> e) and drop other non-ASCII; every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 becomes one hyphen; no leading or trailing hyphen; cut to max_len without ending on a hyphen; return '' when nothing is left. Standard library only, and it must run on Python 3.9 (no match statements, no X | Y type hints). Run it, then commit.
